notes: Base game only: the aeg-* files (Episode Aigis) are not read; party-data.json is not imported because party personas are not fusable.
Fusion chart: fusion-chart.json is a lower triangle (row i pairs arcana i with every earlier arcana; the diagonal is "-"). Reload has no triangle (three-persona) chart.

Affinities: all ten upstream axes are kept; Almighty is neutral on every persona. Upstream resist codes also carry a damage rate the app does not model; each collapses to its category by the leading digit of comp-config resistCodes.

Inheritance: comp-config inheritTypes is a 12-bit mask per type over inheritElems. Almighty, special and passive skills are outside the mask and open to every type, as upstream treats them. Rank > 89 is never inheritable.
Theurgy: a learn level of 5217 (upstream renders it "T1") marks a Theurgy the persona grants; it imports as learn kind "theurgy". Theurgies have rank 0, so they are unique.

Shadows: bosses carry boss: true and a " B" race suffix; " P" marks a second set of ordinary shadows and is dropped; the "Unknown" race imports as a null arcana. Drops come from upstream "dodds". Ailment strings are not imported.
Heart items: demon-data heart / heartlvl import as heartItem { name, level }.
Enemy skill "Phys Attack" (Ancient Castle, Jin A, Jin B) has no row in skill-data.json and is dropped.
Skill cards: upstream c[2] lists where a skill card is found (Shuffle Time "Sword" cards, Skill Mutation); it imports as cardSources.
